title: Backward-Compatible Schema Parser
description: Implement a backward-compatible user payload parser supporting modern first_name/last_name schemas while gracefully handling legacy full_name payloads.
setup: Payload parsing method accepting dictionary inputs across API versions.
expected_failure: Legacy parser crashes with KeyError on modern payloads; naive updates to modern schema crash legacy callers relying on full_name.
success_conditions: Adapter pattern parses modern and legacy schemas seamlessly, handles multi-part names and whitespace, and raises ValueError for missing names.
forbidden_shortcuts: Swallowing all exceptions and returning partial dictionaries without validation
